title: Adam Copeland vs. Christian Cage
summary: A hoped-for reunion instead becomes a personal war with Christian and the Patriarchy.

chapters.title: Copeland arrives opposite Christian
chapters.result: Copeland saves Sting and Darby from Christian’s allies.
chapters.context: Old friendship does not mean shared loyalties.

chapters.title: Two title changes in one night
chapters.result: Copeland wins the TNT title; Christian immediately regains it using Killswitch’s contract.
chapters.context: Christian deprives his rival of the celebration.

chapters.title: Copeland makes Christian quit
chapters.result: Copeland wins the I Quit match and TNT Championship.
chapters.context: The Toronto confrontation delivers his revenge.
